title: MosaicMRI: A Diverse Dataset and Benchmark for Raw Musculoskeletal MRI
abstract: arXiv:2604.11762v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Deep learning underpins a wide range of applications in MRI, including reconstruction, artifact removal, and segmentation. However, progress has been driven largely by public datasets focused on brain and knee imaging, shaping how models are trained and evaluated. As a result, careful studies of the reliability of these models across diverse anatomical settings remain limited. In this work, we introduce MosaicMRI, a large and diverse collection of fully sampled raw musculoskeletal (MSK) MR measurements designed for training and evaluating machine-learning--based methods. MosaicMRI is the largest open-source raw MSK MRI dataset to date, comprising 3,150 volumes and 89,830 slices, including a 3,096-volume 1.5~T core dataset and a 54-volume 0.55~T low-field set. translated_title: MosaicMRI：一个多样化的原始肌肉骨骼MRI数据集与基准
translated_abstract: 深度学习支撑着MRI中的广泛应用，包括图像重建、伪影去除和分割。然而，该领域的进展主要由专注于脑部和膝关节成像的公开数据集推动，这塑造了模型的训练和评估方式。因此，针对这些模型在不同解剖部位场景下可靠性的细致研究仍然有限。在这项工作中，我们推出了MosaicMRI，这是一个大型且多样化的全采样原始肌肉骨骼（MSK）MR测量数据集，专为训练和评估基于机器学习的方法而设计。MosaicMRI是迄今为止最大的开源原始MSK MRI数据集，包含3,150个体数据和89,830个切片，其中包括一个3,096体的1.5T核心数据集和一个54体的0.55T低场数据集。该数据集在体数据采集方向（如轴位、矢状位）、成像对比度（如PD、T1、T2）、解剖部位（如脊柱、膝关节、髋部、脚踝等）方面提供了显著的多样性。
tldr: 本文发布了迄今最大的开源原始肌肉骨骼MRI数据集MosaicMRI，包含3,150个体数据和89,830个切片，涵盖多种采集方向、成像对比度和解剖部位，为训练和评估基于机器学习的MRI方法提供了多样化基准。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MosaicMRI, the largest open-source raw musculoskeletal MRI dataset to date, comprising 3,150 volumes and 89,830 slices with diverse orientations, imaging contrasts, and anatomies, serving as a benchmark for training and evaluating machine-learning-based MRI methods.
